story.headline: A short walk, a slower pour.
story.body: Moof is built around the whisk - matcha and hojicha made to order, not batched ahead of time. We work with two Japanese matcha, Mori and Shiran, alongside hojicha steeped in-house rather than syruped. The bar sits at Eon Shenton, a five-minute walk from Tanjong Pagar MRT, a small pause in the middle of the CBD.
